item: Debug bundle: keyword_write_cost (mention row size, index split estimated without dbstat, measured write rate)
summary: A read-only bundle member that answers the D47 (b) / D46 / D45 measurement the SQLCipher build could not take: the mean mention row size sampled through the read seam, the mentions table and each of its ten indexes estimated as a low/high range against the file (against dbstat on a seeded store: table within 1 percent, every index inside its range), and the mentions and distinct articles written in the last 1 h and 6 h off the created_at index (an empty window says why, never 0), plus the live re-index job's own rate. Deadline-bounded, no score, no network. One recorded raw reference to the physical table (PRAGMA index_list needs its name).
